before_action.text: 胸腰段标记与影像已经核对。先把体位和受压点确认完。
before_action.text_en: The thoracolumbar markings and images match. Let's confirm positioning and pressure points first.

before_action.text: 全麻已建立。残存肌群的监测基线正在复核，体位调整我会同步通报。
before_action.text_en: General anesthesia is established. I'm rechecking the monitoring baseline in the remaining muscle groups and will report during repositioning.

after_resolution.text: 胸腹支垫的位置合适，手术区可以开始准备。
after_resolution.text_en: The chest and abdominal supports are correctly placed. We can prepare the operative site.

after_resolution.text: 透视设备、备用支垫和本台植入物清单已经核对。
after_resolution.text_en: The imaging equipment, spare supports, and implant list have all been checked.

before_action.text: 旧骨折区的骨性标志有偏移。每暴露一节，都重新对照定位。
before_action.text_en: The bony landmarks have shifted around the old fracture. Reconfirm localization at every level we expose.

before_action.text: 电刀、骨膜剥离器和深部牵开器。
before_action.text_en: Cautery, periosteal elevator, and deep retractors.

after_resolution.text: 两侧椎旁肌已按计划牵开。右侧还要保护好节段血管。
after_resolution.text_en: Both paraspinal muscle groups are retracted as planned. We still need to protect the segmental vessels on the right.

after_resolution.text: 导航屏幕的位置调好了，需要进一步透视时可以直接呼叫。
after_resolution.text_en: The navigation screen is positioned; call for more imaging whenever you need it.

before_action.text: 这里的椎弓根方向和普通解剖不完全一样。先确认入点，别让探针偏向椎管。
before_action.text_en: The pedicle angles here aren't entirely normal. Confirm the entry point before the probe goes anywhere near the canal.

before_action.text: 椎弓根探针、球头探针。下一规格的螺钉放在右侧无菌台。
before_action.text_en: Pedicle probe and ball-tip probe. The next screw size is on the right sterile table.

after_resolution.text: 我继续稳住外侧暴露。相邻节段的锚点也需要逐一复核。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll keep the lateral exposure steady. We also need to verify the adjacent anchors one by one.

after_resolution.text: 备用螺钉和锁紧帽数量已核对，接下来可以切换到减压器械。
after_resolution.text_en: The spare screws and locking caps have been counted. We can switch to decompression instruments next.

precision_failed.text: 通道方向不够可靠，别硬推。先重新确认椎弓根的内侧边界。
precision_failed.text_en: The channel direction isn't reliable. Don't force it. Recheck the medial pedicle boundary.

precision_failed.text: 备用探针在这里，螺钉先不要继续进。
precision_failed.text_en: Here's the spare probe. Hold the screw for now.

before_action.text: 截骨前必须把神经周围的限制点看清。临时稳定方案也该现在定下来。
before_action.text_en: Before osteotomy, we need to see the constraints around the nerves. This is also the time to settle the temporary fixation plan.

before_action.text: 左侧空间够用；如果再扩大显露，就要重新检查对侧牵拉。
before_action.text_en: There's enough room on the left; if we widen exposure, recheck traction on the other side.

after_resolution.text: 按选定的分侧步骤推进。每次交换固定前，先确认另一侧仍在承重。
after_resolution.text_en: Proceed with the chosen alternating-side sequence. Before exchanging fixation, confirm the other side is still bearing load.

after_resolution.text: 临时连接棒、持棒器和锁紧帽已备好。
after_resolution.text_en: Temporary rod, rod holder, and locking caps are ready.

before_action.text: 旧瘢痕贴得很紧。找到确实存在的分离平面后再向前走。
before_action.text_en: The old scar is tightly attached. Find a real dissection plane before advancing.

before_action.text: Kerrison 咬骨钳和精细神经剥离子。
before_action.text_en: Kerrison rongeur and fine neural dissector.

after_resolution.text: 我把吸引口移到骨面外侧，避免它碰到硬膜。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll move the suction tip outside the bone surface so it doesn't touch the dura.

after_resolution.text: 神经监测会持续跟进；下一步牵拉或截骨前请提前告诉我。
after_resolution.text_en: Neuromonitoring will continue. Tell me before the next traction or osteotomy step.

precision_failed.text: 硬膜边缘被牵到了。先放松牵开，再找分离面。
precision_failed.text_en: The dural edge has been pulled. Ease the retractor and find the plane again.

precision_failed.text: 这一小段不能盲剥，必须重新辨认神经外侧。
precision_failed.text_en: Don't dissect this part blindly. Identify the lateral side of the nerve again.

before_action.text: 在真正切除椎体以前，必须保证剩余脊柱始终有一侧可靠固定。
before_action.text_en: Before we actually remove the vertebral body, the remaining spine must always have reliable fixation on one side.

before_action.text: 临时棒的长度和锁紧件核对过了，备用规格就在旁边。
before_action.text_en: The temporary rod length and locking parts are checked; a spare size is close by.

after_resolution.text: 我守着对侧固定点。下一步操作时不会放开这个支撑。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll hold the opposite anchor. I won't release this support during the next step.

after_resolution.text: 新增使用的植入物规格已经记录，备用连接棒也已送到手术间。
after_resolution.text_en: The newly used implant specifications are recorded, and a spare rod has been brought into the room.

before_action.text: 先处理病变椎体内部，后壁临近硬膜的部分必须留到暴露足够时再分离。
before_action.text_en: Work inside the diseased vertebral body first. Leave the posterior wall by the dura until exposure is sufficient for separation.

before_action.text: 高速磨钻、咬骨钳。止血材料已放到手边。
before_action.text_en: High-speed drill and rongeur. Hemostatic materials are at hand.

after_resolution.text: 临时支撑还在位。后壁附近要再检查一遍，不能留下游离骨片。
after_resolution.text_en: The temporary support remains in place. Recheck by the posterior wall for loose bone fragments.

after_resolution.text: 这段操作的出血与灌注变化我会重点跟进，需要调整时直接喊我。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll watch bleeding and perfusion closely during this step. Call me if anything needs adjusting.

precision_failed.text: 后壁处理不够干净。先确保临时稳定，再修整骨缘。
precision_failed.text_en: The posterior wall hasn't been cleared well enough. Secure temporary stability before refining the bone edge.

precision_failed.text: 止血材料和更细的咬骨钳已经换上。
precision_failed.text_en: I've switched to hemostatic materials and a finer rongeur.

crisis.text: 术野吸引量明显变了，我先把出血点完全显露出来。
crisis.text_en: Suction has increased sharply. I'll fully expose the bleeding point first.
Bipolar cautery, electrocautery, and hemostatic materials.

crisis.text: 我正在处理循环变化，先把这段操作稳住。
crisis.text_en: I'm managing the circulatory change. Hold this step steady for now.

before_action.text: 截骨空间已经有了，但不能把矫形理解成把两端拼命拉近。
before_action.text_en: We have space from the resection, but correction doesn't mean pulling the two ends together with force.

before_action.text: 上下终板的位置需要复核。前柱的支撑高度决定后面的棒能不能顺利就位。
before_action.text_en: Recheck the upper and lower endplates. Anterior support height will determine whether the rods seat properly.

after_resolution.text: 按刚确定的目标分段复位。先建立支撑，再逐步处理后方连接。
after_resolution.text_en: Restore alignment in stages toward the agreed target. Establish support first, then work on the posterior connection.

after_resolution.text: 融合笼的备选规格和植骨材料都在无菌台。
after_resolution.text_en: The alternative cage sizes and bone graft are on the sterile table.

before_action.text: 先看清支撑面，不能让融合笼压到不可靠的终板边缘。
before_action.text_en: See the support surface clearly. The cage must not press onto an unreliable endplate edge.

before_action.text: 融合笼置入器、试模和准备好的植骨材料。
before_action.text_en: Cage inserter, trials, and prepared bone graft.

after_resolution.text: 我继续保护神经侧的空间。请再检查装置有没有接触到不该碰的组织。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll keep the neural side protected. Check again that the device isn't touching tissue it shouldn't.

after_resolution.text: 备用规格已核对；植入物识别信息会随手术记录一并留存。
after_resolution.text_en: The backup sizes are checked; implant identifiers will go into the operation record.

precision_failed.text: 融合笼的接触面不理想，先退出一点，不要靠力量压进去。
precision_failed.text_en: The cage contact surface isn't right. Back it out a little; don't force it in.

precision_failed.text: 终板受力不均，需要重新确认大小和角度。
precision_failed.text_en: The endplate load is uneven. Recheck the size and angle.

before_action.text: 先让连接棒逐段进入锚点。每一小段矫正后都要核对神经和固定状态。
before_action.text_en: Seat the rod in the anchors one segment at a time. After each small correction, check the nerves and fixation.

before_action.text: 持棒器、复位器和锁紧帽。下一个长度也准备好了。
before_action.text_en: Rod holder, reducer, and locking caps. The next length is ready too.

after_resolution.text: 两侧张力需要重新平衡，别只看正中的排列。
after_resolution.text_en: We need to rebalance tension on both sides, not just look at the midline.

after_resolution.text: 矫形后的神经监测结果正在复核；如果有变化，我会立即通知。
after_resolution.text_en: I'm reviewing the neuromonitoring after correction. I'll report any change at once.

precision_failed.text: 刚才这一步张力增长太快，暂停矫形，核对监测。
precision_failed.text_en: Tension rose too quickly on that step. Pause correction and check monitoring.

precision_failed.text: 我正在复核变化是否来自血压、麻醉或真正的神经信号问题。
precision_failed.text_en: I'm checking whether the change comes from blood pressure, anesthesia, or a real nerve signal.

crisis.text: 监测出现需要复核的变化，先暂停继续矫形。
crisis.text_en: Monitoring shows a change that needs review. Pause further correction.

crisis.text: 保持现有支撑，先检查是不是牵拉或骨性压迫造成的。
crisis.text_en: Maintain the current support. Check whether traction or bony pressure caused it.

crisis.text: 我维持暴露，等监测团队确认后再继续。
crisis.text_en: I'll keep the field exposed until the monitoring team confirms the findings.

before_action.text: 最后逐节复核固定点、连接棒和神经周围的空间；不能只看矫形后的外形。
before_action.text_en: Finally, recheck every anchor, rod, and space around the nerves; don't judge only by the corrected shape.

before_action.text: 限扭起子、骨移植材料和冲洗液。
before_action.text_en: Torque-limiting driver, bone graft, and irrigation.

after_resolution.text: 两侧融合床已经整理。关闭前再看一遍所有可能的出血点。
after_resolution.text_en: Both fusion beds are prepared. Check every possible bleeding point once more before closure.

after_resolution.text: 已使用的植入物型号与数量按实物记录，纱布和器械准备进入最终清点。
after_resolution.text_en: The actual implant models and counts are recorded. We're preparing the final sponge and instrument count.

precision_failed.text: 这个固定点复核没过，关闭前必须重新处理。
precision_failed.text_en: This anchor failed its check. It needs correction before closure.

precision_failed.text: 备用锁紧件和限扭器已经递上。
precision_failed.text_en: The spare locking part and torque limiter are here.

before_action.text: 深部止血和引流位置需要再核对。把这段背部切口安全地关好。
before_action.text_en: Recheck deep hemostasis and drain position. Let's close this back incision safely.

before_action.text: 关闭缝线、皮下器械和最终清点单准备好了。
before_action.text_en: Closure sutures, subcutaneous instruments, and final count sheet are ready.

after_resolution.text: 器械、针和纱布完成终末核对，术后交接资料已备齐。
after_resolution.text_en: Instruments, needles, and sponges have been reconciled, and the postoperative handoff is ready.

after_resolution.text: 我来安排后续体位转换和复苏监测。神经功能评估重点已经交接。
after_resolution.text_en: I'll arrange repositioning and recovery monitoring. The priorities for neurological assessment have been handed over.
